name: deep-signal
nameRationale: Evokes: precision (signal), depth (deep forest green, infrastructure foundation), AI intelligence (signal processing), verifiable/auditable quality. Two-word compound that reads as enterprise-grade without being generic.

figmaAesthetic.description: Dark forest green monochromatic palette (#062914 dark, #155527 primary, #EEF5EE light mint). Bold geometric sans-serif (Plus Jakarta Sans). Enterprise AI talent infrastructure — authoritative and precise, not playful.
figmaAesthetic.biasApplied: All 8 source selections biased toward enterprise/dark/technical systems. Sources chosen for cool-neutral-to-dark color warmth, geometric sans-serif typographic register, and restrained-to-authoritative energy.

themes.sourceSelectionRationale: linear chosen over enpower-trading (randomized pick) for enterprise dark-canvas precision. Dark near-black structure adapted to forest green palette.
themes.twistDescription: No twist — structure copied from linear, all values replaced with Figma non-negotiables in Sub-Phase B.

themes.sourceSelectionRationale: formless-ai chosen over apple-siri for compressed enterprise type scale and dark technical register. Satoshi replaced via Google Fonts CDN.
themes.twistDescription: Letter spacing injection (Twist B, intensity 3): added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.06em on headings and buttons. Creates authoritative precision at display scale.

themes.sourceSelectionRationale: linear chosen over simply-chocolate for enterprise timing vocabulary and restrained precision. simply-chocolate's kinetic energy misaligned with Figma aesthetic.
themes.twistDescription: Duration scaling (slower, Twist A, intensity 2): all duration values multiplied by 1.3×. Produces more considered, authoritative pacing — 0.16s → 0.21s, 0.40s → 0.52s, 1.25s → 1.625s.

themes.sourceSelectionRationale: ochre-tempo selected as randomized pick — fluid clamp-based grid system works well for 1440px enterprise layouts. Max-width adjusted per Figma.
themes.twistDescription: Container max-width adjustment (Twist A, intensity 3): expanded from ochre-tempo's 1600px to 1440px to match Figma frame width. Column gap tightened to 24px. Named layout grids added per Figma section hints (split-2col, cards-3col, cards-4col, grid-footer-5col).
themes.figmaAdjustment: Max-width 1440px, gutters 24-32px per Figma layout hints for split layouts, 3-column product grids, 5-column footer

themes.sourceSelectionRationale: lacuna-grade selected as randomized pick — modular base spacing fits enterprise layout needs at 1440px.
themes.twistDescription: Section-specific breathing room (Twist B, intensity 3): section paddingTop/Bottom increased from ~43px to 96px (+32px breathing room). Hero padding scaled ×1.5 from 64.8px to 128px for heroic enterprise scale.

themes.sourceSelectionRationale: formless-ai selected as randomized pick — dark-canvas interaction tokens with clean ghost hover states match forest green palette.
themes.twistDescription: Focus state enhancement (Twist E, intensity 3): outlineWidth 2px + outlineOffset 2px added across all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, nav-links). Colors updated to forest green accent (#1E7E45).

themes.sourceSelectionRationale: buttermax selected as randomized pick — high-confidence editorial nav adapted to enterprise precision. Theatrical clip-path overlay removed; theatrical height reduced.
themes.twistDescription: Nav height slim + letter spacing (Twist A + D combined): height reduced from 130px to 72px (enterprise precision), letter-spacing 0.08em added to nav links (Twist D, intensity 3). Font updated to Inter from proprietary __myFont for CDN availability.

themes.sourceSelectionRationale: void-spring selected as randomized pick — deep forest green (#09543d) canvas is closest aesthetic match to Figma's #062914 among all 61 valid systems. Both systems share green-dominant dark canvas as identity.
themes.twistDescription: Restraint shift (Twist B, intensity 2): one paragraph rewritten to be more observational — the card border analysis paragraph made more factual/metric, less interpretive. concept_by_video.md generated from scratch.

navFontAvailability.result: Inter is in known-google-fonts.md and assembled typography.json — PASS

subPhaseBOverrides.colorSystem: All Figma non-negotiable colors applied to colors.json and colors.css
subPhaseBOverrides.typeSystem: Plus Jakarta Sans (headings) and Inter (body) set. Google Fonts CDN import added. Proprietary fonts removed.
subPhaseBOverrides.conceptSummary: Both concept_by_image.md and concept_by_video.md rewritten to reflect Griting brand — dark forest green monochromatic, bold geometric sans, enterprise AI talent infrastructure.
subPhaseBOverrides.gridSystem: max-width set to 1440px, gutters 24-32px, named layout grids added per Figma section layout hints.
